url.description: It is the URL of the last request, without its query. A value longer than 500 code points is cut there, unless include_full_header_values is true.

total_url_length.description: Present only when url was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

status_code.description: It is the status of the last answer. A 4xx or 5xx answer is rated too.

redirect_count.description: How many redirects the fetch followed, at most 5.

redirect_to.description: Present only when the last answer is a redirect the fetch did not follow and it names a target. It holds that target, cut as url is.

total_redirect_to_length.description: Present only when redirect_to was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

redirect_limit_reached.description: Present only when the redirect limit stopped the fetch on the site. It is then true.

checked_at.description: When the check ran, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. A cached answer keeps the time of its own check, up to an hour old.

header.description: It is Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection, Set-Cookie or Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

severity.description: It is high, medium or low, fixed for each rule.

result.description: It is pass, warn, fail, or missing when the header is absent. An absent X-XSS-Protection, Set-Cookie or Access-Control-Allow-Origin passes instead.

issues.description: It lists what the rule found.

value.description: The header's value as the site sent it, cut as url is. null when the header is absent, and always null for Set-Cookie.

total_value_length.description: Present only when value was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

cookie_count.description: Present only in the Set-Cookie finding, and always there. It counts the cookies the answer set, 0 when it set none.

remediation.description: Present only when result is not pass. It is a fixed text for the rule.

findings.description: It holds one finding for each of the 9 rules, in a fixed order.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
